## Integration Summary

| Area | Classification | Mapping |
|---|---|---|
| Stable lesson IDs | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | TutorProgram.id |
| Stable skill IDs | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | TutorProgram.targetSkillId and skillGraph |
| Grade-band metadata | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | TutorProgram.gradeBand and item gradeBand |
| Prerequisites | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | PrerequisiteSkillGraphSchema |
| Diagnostic assessment | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | TutorProgram.diagnosticItems |
| Misconception evidence | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | MisconceptionDefinitionSchema.distinguishingEvidence |
| Distinguishing probes | PASS_PROVISIONAL_ADAPTER | English extension links diagnostic item IDs to Core evidence tags |
| Visual explanation plan | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | TutorResponse.boardCommands validated by VisualBoardCommandSchema |
| Spoken explanation | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | TutorResponse.spokenTurn |
| Narration | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | NarrationTrackSchema |
| Transcript | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | NarrationTrackSchema.transcript |
| WebVTT captions | PASS_PROVISIONAL_ADAPTER | Serialized from Core CaptionCue records by the English extension |
| Show Me mode | PASS_PROVISIONAL_ADAPTER | English mode label points to a Core TutorResponse |
| Talk Me Through It mode | PASS_PROVISIONAL_ADAPTER | English mode label points to a Core TutorResponse and SpokenTurn |
| Let's Do One Together mode | PASS_PROVISIONAL_ADAPTER | English mode label points to Core GuidedPractice and TutorResponse contracts |
| Different Example mode | PASS_PROVISIONAL_ADAPTER | English mode label points to an alternate Core teaching sequence |
| Guided practice | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | GuidedPracticeContractSchema |
| Independent mastery checks | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | IndependentMasteryContractSchema |
| Reteaching branches | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | TutorProgram.teachingSequences keyed by misconception |
| Prerequisite remediation | PASS_PROVISIONAL_ADAPTER | English extension routes evidence back to Core skillGraph prerequisite IDs |
| Parent/teacher notes | PASS_PROVISIONAL_ADAPTER | English extension adds subject-specific observation guidance |
| No-media fallback | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | MediaFallbackSchema plus text-only board commands |
| Answer reasoning | PASS_PROVISIONAL_ADAPTER | English extension links delayed reasoning to Core assessment item IDs |
| TutorProgramSchema | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | Validated for all four programs |
| AssessmentItemSchema | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | Validated for every diagnostic, guided, independent, and reassessment item |
| TutorResponseSchema | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | Validated for every mode and teaching turn |
| SpokenTurnSchema | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | Validated for every tutor response |
| VisualBoardCommandSchema | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | Validated for every board command |
| GuidedPracticeContractSchema | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | Validated once per module |
| IndependentMasteryContractSchema | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | Validated once per module |
| MediaFallbackSchema | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | Validated once per module |
| Browser reading intervention | PASS_DIRECT_CORE_V0_2 | Demo consumes the decoding TutorProgram, TutorResponses, items, board commands, and narration |

## Boundary

No GitHub, Supabase, Netlify, Lovable, database, authentication, identity, storage, or progress-synchronization integration is present. Core source has no staged or unstaged diff.
